$doc: docs/DESIGN_Weapon_Layers.md 5l (CE-11033, R-11012/R-11013) - rifle-bursts, the scenario's Judge list: (1) Near (40 m) fires bursts of 2-3 rounds counted 1..N; (2) Mid (120 m, standing) fires 1-2 rounds; (3) Supp (200 m, beyond the 150 m sight, memory only) fires suppressing bursts of 3-5 rounds, every round planned; (4) every pair fires. The rows' burstId / burstRounds / burstIndex are the AI brain's stamp, copied by the muscle into the shot log. A rifleman's sight is 150 m, so the 'seen target beyond 150 m = single round' row is proven by the rules rail, not here.

expect.name: (1) a Near man fires a planned burst of 2-3 rounds
(1) a Near burst reaches its second round (index 2)
(1) a Near burst is never longer than 3 rounds
(2) a Mid man never fires a burst of more than 2 rounds
(3) a Supp man fires a suppressing burst of 3+ rounds
(3) a Supp burst is never longer than 5 rounds
(3) every Supp round belongs to a planned burst
